autoContext: Validates workflow (sub-workflow) action. Covers: file param (path to sub-workflow JSON), includedData param (keys filtered and passed as seed to sub-workflow via build_ctx), and the full sub-workflow result dict stored under the action id. Use dot-notation in a parent includedData entry to extract a specific key from the sub-workflow result (e.g. 'sub_result.final').

test_basic_call._comment: PARAM: file — path to sub-workflow JSON. Result is the full sub-workflow step_output dict stored under action id 'sub_result'.

test_seed_passing._comment: PARAM: includedData — keys filtered by build_ctx before being passed as initial seed to sub-workflow. Sub-workflow receives only 'seed_value' from parent context.

test_dot_extraction._comment: Dot-notation in includedData extracts a specific key from a prior workflow result. 'sub_final=sub_result.final' pulls sub_result['final'] into ctx as 'sub_final'.
